hypotheses.R1_depth_ordering: Layer 17 median first-role energy exceeds layer 0 by at least 0.08 in every random residual sketch on FineWeb.
hypotheses.R2_low_residual_role_rank: Four components capture at least 0.75 median role-direction energy at both layers in every FineWeb sketch.
hypotheses.R3_sketch_stability: Across-sketch coefficient of variation of median first-role energy is below 0.05 at both layers.
hypotheses.R4_ood_residual_role_subspaces: Mean top-four role-subspace overlap with FineWeb is at least 0.60 for both OOD corpora at both layers.
hypotheses.R5_semantic_probe_not_rank_artifact: Residual-sketch median first-role energy differs from the prior 14-semantic-query estimate by at most 0.10 at both layers.
